In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] delegation of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was dispatched on a '''mission to Virgillia 7''' to establish peace talks in the [[Virgillian Civil War]] between the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] and the [[Aristocracy]]. The delegation was made up of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Everen Ettene]] and [[Ludwin Katarkus]], along with their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Halagad Ventor]] and [[Danyawarra]]. Upon arriving in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]], the envoys' [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was attacked by dissenters, and destroyed. The four Jedi were presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the Jedi Order, and a [[Jedi funeral/Legends|memorial service]] was held at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="HNN45" /> However, Ventor and Danyawarra had actually survived the crash. After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the two Padawans were [[Rescue of Halagad Ventor and Danyawarra|rescued]] by Jedi Master [[Ashka Boda]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], and the latter's weapons master [[Giles Durane]].<ref name="SW:ACWS" />
